title: Hussain Ka Matam
body:
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ba Khuda Hai Tujse Wada,
Na Rukega Ye Silsila.
Waba Se Kese Rukega -Hussain Ka Matam
Her Ek Haal Me Hoga-Hussain Ka Matam
Hame To Hath Milane Se Sab Ne Rok Liya
Magar Ye Hath Karega-Hussain Ka Matam
Bicha Ke Farshe Aza Fatema S.A. Ko Razi Karo
He Ek Farz Hamara-Hussain Ka Matam
Gum E Hussain Me Rona Hamari Kismat He
Muqaddaro Ka Sahara Hussain Ka Matam
Suna Jo Mene Alam Se To Aa Rahi Thi Sada
Abhi To Or Badhega -Hussain Ka Matam
Labbaik Labbaik Labbaik Ya Hussain
Labbaik Labbaik Labbaik Ya Hussain
Hussain Aap Ke Dar Pe Bulaiye Humko
Karunga Dekh Ke Roza Hussain Ka Matam
Gum E Hussain Me Rone Ko Jo Kahe Bidaat
Tamacha Unko Lagega -Hussain Ka Matam
Kisi Bhi Hal Me Hoga Ye Ruk Nahi Sakta
Dua E Fatema Zehra S.A.-Hussain Ka Matam
Hussain Sunte Hi Bacche Ne Nanhe Hatho Se
He Maa Ki God Se Sikha -Hussain Ka Matam
Milenge Qabr Me Hyder To Us Khuda Ki Kasam
Me Sath Unke Karunga -Hussain Ka Matam
Pule Sirat Pe Misl E Asa E Musa Ke
Hamare Sath Chalega -Hussain Ka Matam
Padhengey Hazrat E Mehdi Atfs Toh Baad Majlis Ke
Karengey Hazrat E Isa Hussain Ka Matam
Hussain Naam E Mubarak Hamari Saan'sey Hai
Humey Hai Jaan Se Pyara Hussain Ka Matam
Raza Ne Keh Ke Ye Akbar Kalam Ko Rok Liya
Bayan Mujse Na Hoga Hussain Ka Matam
